results.title: AFP Chief of Staff reports HADR accomplishments, receives praises from PRRD
results.intro_html:
CAMP AGUINALDO, Quezon City—The Armed Forces of the Philippines’ Chief of Staff General Andres C Centino PA reported to President Rodrigo Duterte the military’s accomplishments in its response to Typhoon Odette via video teleconferencing during the "Talk to the People" hosted by PRRD on 17 January 2022 from Davao City.

“Our personnel were immediately deployed to help in the prevention, mitigation, and response operations before, during, and after the typhoon to assist in the delivery and transport of relief goods, supplies, equipment, and personnel in the affected areas,” General Centino said.

results.title: Chiefs of Defense Meeting
results.intro_html: Armed Forces of the Philippines Chief of Staff General Andres C Centino PA joins the virtual Chiefs of Defense Meeting on 13 January 2022. General Centino discussed the AFP's strategic priorities for 2022 in the meeting hosted by the US INDO-PACIFIC Command and attended by 24 top and senior military leaders from 24 countries. This event is a continuation of the primary Chiefs of Defense meeting held in August 2021 in Honolulu, Hawaii. (Photos by SN1 Viluan/PAO, AFP)

results.title: AFP Statement on the Passing of Former Chief of Staff General Lisandro Abadia
results.intro_html: The Armed Forces of the Philippines extends its sincerest condolences to the family and friends of General Lisandro Abadia, former AFP Chief of Staff.

results.title: AFP Statement on Chief of Staff, AFP testing Positive for COVID-19
results.intro_html: The Armed Forces of the Philippines confirms that the AFP Chief of Staff, General Andres Centino has tested positive for COVID-19, yesterday.

results.title: Number 1 Most Wanted CPP/NPA/NDF Leader in Mindanao killed
results.intro_html: MAWAB, DAVAO DE ORO - Menandro Villanueva alias BOK, the longest-serving Secretary of Southern Mindanao Regional Committee (SMRC), currently the Secretary of Komisyong Mindanao (KOMMID), Commanding Officer of the NPA’s National Operations Command (NOC), and member of the POLITBURO of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Philippines (CPP) was killed in an encounter against the troops under 1001st Infantry Brigade at Brgy Libudon, Mabini, Davao de Oro on Wednesday evening, January 5, 2022.

results.title: New Year's Message of the AFP Chief of Staff General Andres C Centino PA
results.intro_html: It is with immense pride and joy that I extend my felicitations to the gallant men and women of the Armed Forces of the Philippines as we welcome the New Year together as one big AFP family. A happy and blessed new year to one and all!

results.title: AFP Mobile Kitchen in Cebu receives donations from San Miguel Foundation
results.intro_html: CAMP AGUINALDO, Quezon City – The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) will use the canned goods worth P500,000 donated by San Miguel Foundation, Inc. to feed typhoon victims in Cebu Province through the AFP Mobile Kitchen.

results.title: Be a hero to our heroes' children in the 6th HERO Golf Cup
results.intro_html: The HERO Golf Cup is an annual charity golf tournament organized by the HERO (Help Educate and Rear Orphans) Foundation, Inc. Now on its 6th year, all proceeds of the tournament will go to help fund the educational needs of orphaned children and dependent siblings of soldiers who were permanently incapacitated or killed due to enemy action or during disaster relief operations..
